trailhead.name: Blue Lakes Trailhead (Blue Lakes Road, CR 850)

identifiedBy.fact: 14ers.com Fletcher Mountain Southeast Ridge route: trailhead Blue Lakes, ~11,700 ft, via Blue Lakes road (850) from CO 9

otherFacts.value: CO 9 about 8 mi south of Breckenridge, west on Blue Lakes Rd (850); gate near 1.4 mi, if closed park there and walk ~0.75 mi to the dam

notes: Page is for this exact route (name matches). No trailhead coordinate printed (only a summit-area pair); not in officialCandidates. Name for OSM match: Blue Lakes Trailhead, Summit County CO. The gate/closure means the usable parking may be the closed-gate area ~1.4 mi up the road.

trailhead.name: Isberg Pass Trailhead (Isberg Trailhead, Sierra National Forest, near Granite Creek Campground)

identifiedBy.fact: trip report starts at Isberg Trailhead, Isberg Pass trail via the Niche, Sadler Lake; pantilat.wordpress.com 2013 also uses Isberg Pass Trailhead

otherFacts.value: Beasore Road; rocky stretch, one party parked ~0.6 mi short

notes: WEAK. Two opened trip reports use Isberg TH; SummitPost (search summary only, page 403, NOT opened) calls Isberg Pass the most direct and lists Tuolumne Meadows and Devils Postpile starts as alternatives; earlier passes saw reports from Tuolumne Meadows (1999) and Sunrise Lakes (2021). No page calls any start the standard route. No coordinate from an allowed source; Isberg TH not in officialCandidates. Reviewer may prefer stuck.

identifiedBy.fact: climb13ers 'French Mtn. SE Ridge & flank Route' trailhead: South Halfmoon Creek TH, 10,290 ft, FR110J

otherFacts.value: FR110J south from Halfmoon Creek, cross South Halfmoon Creek; high clearance recommended
14ers.com French/Frasco/Casco combo starts at Halfmoon Creek (10,240 ft) lower TH on FR110J before the creek crossing; 11.75 mi, 4600 ft

notes: Strong identification: climb13ers' only French Mountain route is named SE Ridge. Coordinate converted from the DMS printed on that page (39 09 02.04 N, 106 27 19.04 W). Not in officialCandidates (USFS list has North Halfmoon, a different trailhead). The page prints a different coordinate for the Mt. Massive TH, so this is a separate point up the road. OSM name match 'South Halfmoon' still worth a check.

identifiedBy.fact: Trailhead: South Lake; over Bishop Pass, Dusy Basin, north ridge to notch, SE face chute

notes: Climber.org 2013/1841 (opened) states South Lake outright; an earlier pass also had 2001/758. Search results show every approach going Bishop Pass and Dusy Basin. The two placements are ~35 m apart. The USFS point is the second source for the first placement.
